title: devctx_ptr NULL check in crypto2dev_hash is unreachable dead code
description: In crypto2dev_hash() (port.c ~line 836), after the hash-type switch, there is: 'if (devctx_ptr == NULL) return BAD_FUNC_ARG;'. The switch has a default branch that returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE, so every non-default case assigns devctx_ptr. The NULL check can never trigger. It is dead code that adds noise. Suggested rewrite: remove the check; add a comment above the switch that the default handles all unsupported types.
